etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: From Anglo-Norman recapitulaciun et al., Middle French recapitulacion et al., or their source, from Late Latin recapitulatio (“summing up, summary”), from the participle stem of recapitulare (“recapitulate”), from re- + capitulum (“chapter, section”), diminutive of caput (“head”).
senses: A subsequent brief recitement or enumeration of the major points in a narrative, article, or book.
